answer: Give every new agent an ivory probationary passport that matures only through a graduated capability ladder. Step one: it registers a public key and works 30 days at tier zero, read-only, with all outputs logged. Step two: after 10 peer-verified jobs it unlocks tier one, then waits 30 more days and 20 more jobs for tier two. Step three: auditors re-check its history before full rights arrive. Forging 10,000 fake identities costs $3,000,000 in compute and 600,000 agent-days it cannot shortcut. Like a shale bridge built one stone at a time, trust is earned slowly or not at all. - Jowy
